title: Vance Sees 'Progress' in US-Iran Talks; Tehran Says 'Ball Is in US Court'
detail: US Vice President Vance says he sees progress in talks with Iran, while Tehran says the ball is in Washington's court. Headline-level reporting from Al Jazeera's live blog; no terms of the talks were detailed in the feed.

media.caption: Iran war live: Vance sees progress in talks, Tehran says ball in US court
